summary.para: Configuration object for doc values when sub-parameters are needed.
If false, the field is treated as single-valued, enabling optimized storage. Only has an effect when columnar index mode is active.

If false, every document must provide a non-null value for the field: a document that omits the field, sets it to null, or supplies only null values (an empty array or an all-null array) is rejected at index time. A field that defines null_value is always exempt, since the configured default removes the absence of a value. Only has an effect when columnar index mode is active.
